digest.component_or_area: LLM provider resolution and OpenAI integration
propositions: Hosted OpenAI providers (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt without custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default under pydantic-ai 1.107.2.

Custom endpoints (top-level base_url, per-slot endpoint, per-candidate endpoint) and non-hosted OpenAI-compatible vendors (deepseek, grok, moonshotai, xai, groq, cerebras, gateway/openai) remain on openai-chat: with no alternative.
Explicit openai-chat: qualifier acts as a deprecated compatibility surface with a once-per-run deprecation notice scheduled for removal in v1.0.0.

Provider resolution must thread endpoint information through _resolve_target, resolve_class, resolve_fallback_chain, and related functions to determine whether to emit openai-chat: or openai-responses:.
Contract tests must validate the behavioural diff between openai-responses: and openai-chat: paths (structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, custom base URLs).
